title: Flight Lab aerodynamic coefficient document (FL-602 / F-02)
description: A Flight Lab aerodynamic model YAML: what orbitopt.flightlab.sixdof.aero.AeroModel loads. Two shapes are allowed. 'kind: coefficient-tables' (what AeroModel.to_document writes) carries one table per coefficient under `coefficients`, each with its own `axes` subset of {mach, alpha_deg, beta_deg}, the axis nodes inline or shared at document level, and a nested `values` list rectangular in the axis order; that is the shape a real CFD/wind-tunnel reduction is tabulated into. 'kind: axisymmetric' carries instead the small description a hand-built booster gets from a diameter and a curve slope -- a `ca` Mach breakout plus `cn_alpha_per_rad` and `static_margin` -- which the loader promotes to full tables; packaged illustrative models use it and say so in `provenance`. Axes are strictly increasing, and the extrapolation policy of a table ('clamp' default, 'linear', 'error') is what happens outside the tabulated range.

area_m2.description: Reference area S of Cx = F/(q S).

diameter_m.description: axisymmetric kind only: body diameter, recorded for the record (area wins when both are given).
axisymmetric kind only: body diameter, recorded for the record (area wins when both are given).

span_m.description: Roll-moment reference length b; defaults to length_m.

cl_p.description: Roll-damping derivative cl_p (per nondimensional rate c*p/2V).

cm_q.description: Pitch damping, negative for a damped body.

cn_yaw_r.description: Yaw damping, negative for a damped body.

ca.description: axisymmetric kind: [[mach, ca], ...] drag breakout, linear between nodes.

static_margin.description: axisymmetric kind: centre of pressure behind the CG, in reference lengths; cm_alpha = -static_margin * cn_alpha.

Extrapolation.description: Outside the tabulated range: hold the edge value (default, what numpy.interp does), continue the end segment's slope, or raise.

Provenance.description: Where the coefficients came from; packaged illustrative models must say 'illustrative'.

axes.description: Independent variables of this table, in nested-list order.

values.description: Nested lists, rectangular over `axes`; a scalar or a shallower nesting is broadcast by the loader.
